# Name: # require another partition-table change (which forces a full USB re-flash and
# is impractical once devices are in the field). Everything through ota_1 keeps
# its historical offset so the OTA app slots are unchanged; the space after the
# app slots was reorganized:
#   - the unused "human_face_det" (face-detect vestige) and "storage" (never
#     mounted) SPIFFS partitions were reclaimed;
#   - a "coredump" partition was added so panics/WDT resets capture a backtrace;
#   - "dbglog" is a dedicated persistent debug-log ring (log_persist.cpp);
#   - "reserved" carves out the remaining ~4.9MB of previously-unallocated tail
#     as named scratch space for future use (config blobs
#     etc.) WITHOUT needing another table change.
# NOTE for already-fielded devices that only receive an app OTA (not a full
# flash): their on-flash table still has the OLD layout. log_persist looks up
# "dbglog" and falls back to the legacy "human_face_det" label
# simply stays inactive until the device is next full-flashed. No re-flash is
# required to pick up the persistent-log improvement.
